findings.claim: A ticket's Outcome section is written after review by nature, and the reviewed-tree fingerprint covers the ticket file, so verify-delivery refuses every ticket that documents itself honestly
findings.failure_scenario: Every one of the remaining tickets reaches delivery, adds its Outcome, and is refused; the obvious workaround is to write the Outcome after the receipt, which puts the tree that merges out of step with the tree the receipt attests
findings.resolution: The convention is now in CLAUDE.md: the Outcome is written before advancing out of review, and only the receipt hash, which cannot exist earlier, goes in the pull request body. This ticket took the non-code documentation path for attempt 4 to prove it
